chromatic-title.what: A serif line slides in from the right and settles word by word over colour fields cut on the 16 fps picture cadence, then cuts to a paper card where each word takes its own gradient under a slow exponential push.

slots.fields: array of image sequences or stills, each {frames|src, dur, at, fit, focal, rate, loop, dissolve}
slots.card: paper texture slot {src, fit, focal, color} plus at, hold, palette, gradients
slots.images: preset only: the 66 field pictures the replica schedule indexes

text_params.font: default ES Serif (preset uses ES Line)
text_params.size: px or measured to fill 0.84 of the width

timing.scale: stretches slide, settles, push and field durations
timing.beats: cut fields and land the card on beats; at and beats are not scaled

source_shots: s3 shots 2-9, source frames 244-339 (10.167-14.167 s)

presets.replica-s3-line: measured per-frame keys of s3 shots 2-9; replica score min shot SSIM 0.980, max rel flow 0.143, 7 of 7 cuts

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.what: The film's pointer: rounded kite, white keyline, translucent grey body; travels in 4 to 10 frame ease-out hops on the 16 fps cadence, leans with the hand, squashes to 0.85 for one picture on a click. Its drawing and travel are the es-cursor kit, which any block can copy to carry a pointer.
params: stops [{x, y, at, click, th, hop}]

lockup-scramble.does: One serif line turns into the next by losing letters at random while the new line's letters arrive in place in violet; the finished line turns black, holds with a barely visible breathing scale, then its tail changes face on every second picture while the line steps up in size towards the frame edge.

slots.name: paper
slots.notes: optional ground under everything; the scene background shows without it

slots.name: tile
slots.notes: {src, fit, focal, zoom, rect, until}: a photo tile left over from the previous block, removed at until

slots.name: grid
slots.notes: {x0, dx, y0, dy, color, until}: grid rules left over from the previous block

text.name: to
text.face: ES Serif lead plus cycle faces
text.notes: the lockup; lead words stay serif, the tail cycles mono, pixel, humanist, bitmap, grotesk; 84.4 px cap, shrunk to fit the margins

text.name: faces
text.face: mono, pixel, humanist, bitmap, grotesk, serif

source_shots: shot 8, source frames 128 to 179 (5.333 to 7.500 s): glyph-scramble, hold, font-cycle

demo.verdict: Portrait 1080x1920, new words and a stand-in tile: the scramble, violet arrivals, black hold and font cycle all read, and the cycle grows to 0.96 of the narrow width instead of cropping.

lockup-scramble.name: lockup-scramble

ghost-word-grow.name: ghost-word-grow
ghost-word-grow.does: A giant ghost word fills the paper behind everything; a small serif word at the centre; photo tiles pop in one picture at a time; the word steps up x2 in one picture; violet chips land around a tile pulled in behind the word, which grows on an accelerating curve into the cut with its chips streaking outward.

slots.tiles[]: image slots with optional box (frame fractions) and art overlay riding the tile
slots.select: image slot pulled in behind the word; the growing box is a window onto it

text.ghost: ghost word (defaults to word, repeated across the row)
text.cap: small cap height px at a 1080 short side (85)

timing.beats: first beats pop the tiles, the next one steps the word

presets.replica-s6-1-2: s6 shots 1 and 2 frame for frame (needs ES Source Serif from work/blocks/_style-s67 and calibration plates)

ghost-word-grow.hands_off_to: crop-select (the selected tile keeps growing in the next shot)

tile-scatter.does: Grid paper fills with picture tiles that pop and drift into whole cells and lowercase serif words that land one per beat on paper cards and walk a cell at a time; then the cards cut to one centred line that swells while the grid grows and the tiles drop out a few per picture. Steps on the 16 fps cadence.

slots.name: tiles[]
slots.notes: any count; {src, fit, focal [x,y], zoom, cells [cw,ch] or aspect, label}; whole-cell sizes, crop and drift are code; placeholder when no src

slots.name: paper
slots.notes: optional paper texture under the rules; flat --color-paper-grid otherwise

slots.name: images[]
slots.notes: preset only: one picture per held tile pose (195 for replica-s1-shot8)

text.name: words
text.notes: array or string; card width from glyph metrics, whole cells, two at least; cap 58 px at 1080, tracking 2 px

text.name: line
text.notes: the words joined; lineScale [1.14, 1.34] of the word size; wraps to up to three balanced rows before shrinking to fit 64 px margins

timing.beats: one word lands per beat (s after t0); even when absent

source_shots: s1 shot 8, film frames 79-127 (3.292-5.333 s)

demo.verdict: Reads in the film's hand at portrait: seven stand-in tiles (three re-cropped by focal and zoom) and five new words scatter, walk without colliding and gather into a three-row line clear of the tiles.

tile-scatter.limits: General mode does not swap pictures inside resting tiles and walks words on shortest paths rather than the film's deliberate detours; the tile-free band is measured from the frame centre, so lineY away from 0.5 can put a tile under the line.
tile-scatter.name: tile-scatter

endcard-typeon.what: End card: a sentence types on word by word inside violet pixel-bar handles that open past the line and pull in to corner chips; the line cuts to diagonal pixel-step brackets around a mark slot, the mark grows while the brackets shrink, blink faint and go; the lockup cuts in sliding left on an exponential ease and the tagline drops in on one frame.

slots.mark: inline SVG (currentColor) or image {src, fit, focal, aspect}
slots.wordmark: artwork {src, fit, focal, aspect, h, cap} or text {text, size, tracking}, optional

text_params.sentence: any words, EditorialSelect Serif, sized to 0.766 of frame width and fitted
text_params.tagline: string or false, 0.63 of body size

camera-rig.name: camera-rig
camera-rig.does: The film's camera on any image slot or image sequence: push, punch on a cut, pull-back, steady pull, settle, drift and tilt as measured presets, scale in log space, on the film's cadences (16 fps on stills, ones on footage); exact per-frame keys or homographies for replica shots. Other blocks carry the same engine (window.__esCamera) for their own moves.

slots.slot: image slot: src, fit, focal [x, y], zoom, or frames [src...] with fps for a sequence; no src draws a labelled placeholder
slots.swaps: [{ frame | t, src }] picture changes inside the shot

params.preset: push | punch | push-soft | push-hard | pull-back | pull-steady | pull-settle | drift | tilt | hold | replica-s7-A
params.cam: one move or a list: at, dur or frames, scale, from, to, dx, dy, r, origin, ease, cadence, phase, keys, mats
params.box: [x, y, w, h] frame px (default full frame)
params.ground: token name or CSS behind the picture
params.keepCover: default true: a pull starts far enough in that the picture always covers the box
params.beats: moves without at start on beats[i]

timing.cadence: 16 fps for push and punch, ones for pulls, drift and tilt (overridable)

billboard.what: Artwork put up in the world: a logotype (ES Serif word or traced paths), small type lines and rules laid out in a board's flat space and warped onto a plane in a photograph by a homography (matrix3d), with ink colour, glow and edge blur matched to the plate and foreground cut-outs drawn over the type; the picture, the plane and the cut-outs move as one under an es-camera move, by default the film's pull-back.

slots.slot: the photograph {src, fit, focal, zoom, size, cutout} or a photo sequence {frames: [...]} played one picture per film frame
slots.slot.cutout: the same picture on transparency, drawn over the type (type behind subject)
slots.fgs: per-frame cut-outs aligned with the frames (moving occluders)
slots.panel: printed ground on the plane: {color} or an image slot {src, focal, light, scrim}

text_params.word / art.logo: logotype in ES Serif: text, cap (0.3 of board height), width (0.84), y (0.56), align; or d + box for a path set
text_params.art.lines: small type blocks {at: below|tl|tr|bl|br|above, text, face: mono|grotesk|humanist|serif, size 0.045, leading, tracking}
text_params.art.rules: [x, y, w, h] shares of the board
text_params.art.items: replica item list (path, text with per-glyph xs, rect)
text_params.ink: token, default type-light (replica: per-frame from the plate)
text_params.glow: [blur, opacity], default [0.006 W, 0.45]; null for none
text_params.soften: edge blur, default about 0.6 frame px
text_params.quad / quadSpace: four corners tl tr br bl in frame px, or in the picture's px with quadSpace image and slot.size

timing.cam: es-camera move or list (pull-back, pull-steady, push, push-soft, push-hard, drift, tilt, keys, mats); presets on ones for footage, cadence 16 for the graphic hand on stills
timing.beats: a cam move with at {beat: i} starts on beats[i]
timing.sequence: photo sequences and per-frame keys advance one source frame per film frame

genre-word-card.does: A run of hard-cut cards: one serif word centred between four selection-handle chips over a full-bleed picture; on each cut the picture and word change together, the letters snap from crowded or spread to their set spacing over six frames, and the handles glide to the new word's box with a segmented streak. Optional step-up nests a second handle set on a bigger word. Steps on the 16 fps cadence.

slots.name: cards[].image (images[], or image in a one-shot preset)
slots.notes: {src, fit, focal [x,y], zoom, scrim, label} or {seq: [{f|t, src}]}; full bleed or imageBox [x,y,w,h] shares; crop and focal are code; placeholder when no src

text.name: cards[].word (words[])
text.notes: any length, laid out from glyph metrics; cap 102 px at 1080; wordX/wordY place ink centre and baseline (never x/y); tracking in em; color token (type-light) per card

duration.unit: per card; a run of 5 or 6 cards lasts 2.5 to 4 s

timing.durScale: multiplies the cut lengths (default cycle 10,14,13,15,12,8 frames)

source_shots: s1 shots 1 to 7, film frames 0-78 (0.000-3.292 s): Art, Design, Photography, Editorial, Film, Ecommerce, the Ecommerce step

replica.also: replica-s1-cards over frames 0-71: 5 of 5 cuts on frame; every shot passes (0.989-0.997, flow <= 0.149) with colour tags matched to the source; as rendered shot 6 reads 0.971 from compare.py's bt709 decode and shot 5 flow 0.153 (work/blocks/genre-word-card/replica-cards-2)

demo.verdict: Reads as the film's genre run in portrait: five new words over stand-in pictures cut on the tightening rhythm, letters snap, handles glide and streak, and the last word steps up with nested handles; light pictures needed a scrim or ink type to stay legible.

genre-word-card.limits: Chip colours sampled from the picture must be passed in (render cannot read pixels); chips land and hold instead of creeping between cuts; the film's letterpress speckle is matched only as a mean fill tone in the preset.
genre-word-card.name: genre-word-card

select-handles.does: The four-chip selection, reusable around any element: chips on a box's corners glide to the next box on the snap ease (from a frame early) as segmented streaks turned along the path, jump to a bigger box while the old set lingers three frames, pop with a landing size, or collapse inward. Every glide is sampled on the 16 fps cadence. The engine is window.__esSelect, shared with any block that draws a selection.

duration.unit: a glide is 6 frames; a selection holds as long as the plan wants

timing.keys: [{t, box|rect+pad, mode pop|glide|jump|collapse, dur, lead, linger, settle, chip, chip_from, color(s)}]
timing.beats: key times when keys give none

source_shots: s1 shots 1 to 7, film frames 0-78 (chip-rects): glide frames 9-15, streak pieces on frames 10 and 12, nested jump on frame 72

replica.note: picture and word from genre-word-card with handles off; every handle pixel is this block's

demo.verdict: Violet handles select a picture, streak to the word under it, nest onto the word as it steps up, glide back and collapse as four streaks pointing at the centre; reads as the film's selection.

select-handles.limits: Chips land and hold (the film's keep creeping); sampled chip colours must be passed in; the two-piece streak approximates the measured per-frame streak shapes.
select-handles.name: select-handles

type-fill-echo.name: type-fill-echo
type-fill-echo.what: Dark serif line glides in from the right, settles centred, creeps, punches up, fills its letters with a frame-fixed picture, then image-filled echo rows at 1.66x land above and below, cropped by the frame.

slots.fill: picture seen only inside the letters {src, fit, focal}, fixed to the frame

text.text: any length, ES Serif, centred on its ink from font metrics
text.cap: cap height share of frame height, 0.171
text.maxWidth: ink share of width at the punch, 0.9

icon-tile.what: A violet tile carrying a mark slot arrives on paper with a slow push: notches, mark faint then white then black, a one-frame step to twice the size, four handle chips arriving per corner, gliding out, pressed black and pulled in, out again; lavender step; carried off by the accelerating camera pan.

slots.mark: inline SVG in currentColor or image {src, fit, scale, x, y}; looks faint, white, black; placeholder lobes when empty

params.colors: tile, fade, chip, chip_fade, chip_press, notch, notch_pale, ink, white (palette names)
params.keys: white, black, step, chips, press, release, lavender, pan (s from t0, beat-snappable)
params.beats: drive step, chips, press, pan when keys are absent
params.pan: {dx, dy, frames, K} or false; share with giant-type-pass

about: Reusable blocks of the editorial-select hand. Each is library/<name>.html (CONTRACT.md) with library/<name>.md; plan new pieces from this list first and from the grammar second.
